page.overview:
Who is Lena Orlov?

Lena Orlov was a character in Death on the Titan.

Lena Orlov was the shift supervisor on the Sand Titan. She was questioned following the suspiscious death of Chief Jarrick Thorne and when asked about the nature of their relationship, she insisted they were just colleagues. When told that Tessa Lim had said they had a close relationship, Orlov denied this, suggesting that Lim was trying to deflect suspiscion from herself. Upon being played a recording which contradicted her claim, Orlov called Lim a "bitch" for recording the conversations of her crewmates. Admitting that she was romantically involved with Thorne, Orlov declared that she had no reason to harm him. Revealing that she had signals training that would allow her to decode the messages that had been sent to Thorne, she was asked what they said.
